edges.reason: msg.sender is read in stake for balance accounting, transferFrom and the contract restriction check.
msg.sender is read in withdraw for balance accounting and token transfer.
msg.sender is read in getReward to determine the reward recipient.
msg.sender used in exit through balanceOf(msg.sender) and getReward.
checkStart modifier compares block.timestamp against starttime, creating timestamp dependency.
checkStart modifier gates withdraw on block.timestamp.
checkStart modifier gates getReward on block.timestamp.
lastTimeRewardApplicable returns Math.min(block.timestamp, periodFinish).
notifyRewardAmount branches and computes rewardRate/periodFinish directly from block.timestamp.
stake authorizes based on msg.sender == tx.origin, which is an unsafe origin-based check.
stake amount parameter flows into totalSupply/balance updates and safeTransferFrom.
withdraw amount parameter flows into totalSupply/balance updates and safeTransfer.
notifyRewardAmount reward parameter flows into rewardRate computation.
earned account parameter flows into balanceOf and userRewardPerTokenPaid lookups.
_contractAddress is written into contractWhitelist in addToWhitelist.
_contractAddress is written into contractWhitelist in removeFromWhitelist.
newOwner parameter flows into the _owner state assignment.
newOperator_ parameter flows into the _operator state assignment.
mithShare token instance is the target of the reward safeTransfer.
lpt token instance is pulled from the staker in LPTokenWrapper.stake.
lpt token instance is sent to the staker in LPTokenWrapper.withdraw.
starttime is compared with block.timestamp inside the checkStart modifier on stake.
starttime determines the pre/post start branching and periodFinish in notifyRewardAmount.
periodFinish caps the reward-eligible timestamp in lastTimeRewardApplicable.
rewardRate multiplies elapsed time in rewardPerToken.
lastUpdateTime is subtracted in rewardPerToken.
rewardPerTokenStored is the accumulator base in rewardPerToken.
userRewardPerTokenPaid is subtracted in earned.
rewards mapping adds previously accrued rewards in earned.
_totalSupply is returned by totalSupply().
_balances mapping is read by balanceOf().
contractWhitelist authorizes contract callers in stake.
stake calls super.stake after modifiers execute.
withdraw calls super.withdraw after modifiers execute.
exit invokes withdraw(balanceOf(msg.sender)).
exit invokes getReward().
LPTokenWrapper.stake performs an external safeTransferFrom on the LP token, enabling callback into the pool.
LPTokenWrapper.withdraw performs an external safeTransfer on the LP token, enabling callback into the pool.
getReward performs an external safeTransfer of reward tokens after state update, a reentrancy pathway.
rewardPerToken calls lastTimeRewardApplicable.
earned calls rewardPerToken.
earned calls balanceOf(account).
updateReward modifier on notifyRewardAmount calls rewardPerToken.
setRewardDistribution is owner-restricted and writes rewardDistribution.
addToWhitelist is operator-restricted and mutates contractWhitelist.
removeFromWhitelist is operator-restricted and mutates contractWhitelist.
_transferOperator writes the privileged _operator address.
transferOwnership is onlyOwner and writes _owner.
renounceOwnership is onlyOwner and clears _owner.
A malicious mithShare token can re-enter getReward during safeTransfer.
A malicious lpt token can re-enter withdraw during safeTransfer.
A malicious or whitelisted lpt token can re-enter stake during safeTransferFrom.

normalization_plan.reason: stake amount parameter is a temporary argument whose effect is fully realized inside the stake function's balance and transfer logic.
withdraw amount parameter is consumed entirely within the withdraw function's accounting and transfer.
reward parameter only influences rewardRate/periodFinish computed inside notifyRewardAmount.
account parameter is used only for lookups inside the earned view function.
whitelist address parameter is written to contractWhitelist only through the operator whitelist functions.
newOwner parameter is only used to set the _owner state variable in transferOwnership.
newOperator_ parameter directly feeds the _operator assignment via _transferOperator.
local reward cache exists only to gate the safeTransfer of rewards inside getReward.
remaining is a transient computation inside notifyRewardAmount feeding rewardRate.
leftover is a transient computation inside notifyRewardAmount feeding rewardRate.
